page.title: Style guide
page.intro: Every design token and every component in all its states. The switches preview a theme and a density on this page only; your own preferences stay as they are.

actions.resetPreview: Back to my theme and density

code.intro: The code panel: a header with the file, the language, Format and Find; the editor with line numbers, fold markers, the active line, bracket matching and the diagnostics underlined; the diagnostics listed below (a row jumps to its position); a status line with the caret position and the counts. It fills the height it is given and follows the theme and density.

palette.label: Highlighting
palette.note: Preview only: both palettes are on show until one is chosen at sign-off. ?palette=refined opens the page with it.

code.swatchesNote: Read from the computed styles; each colour needs 4.5:1 on the editor background.

colors.intro: Values and contrast ratios are read from the computed styles of the theme shown. Text needs 4.5:1, control borders, focus rings and status colours 3:1.
colors.noPairs: Translucent; not used as a text background

type.intro: Inter for the interface, JetBrains Mono for code, UIDs and paths.

spacing.intro: A 4 px grid: --sf-space-N is N × 4 px.

elevation.intro: Dark surfaces swallow soft shadows, so the dark theme uses deeper shadows and a light hairline.

zIndex.intro: Components take their stacking order from these tokens, never from a raw number.

motion.intro: Short and functional; with reduced motion every duration collapses to nothing.

density.intro: Control and row heights and paddings in the {density} density. Switch the density above to see them change.

buttons.iconOnlyNote: An icon-only button takes its accessible name from its label, which is also its tooltip.

forms.intro: Every control inside sf-field. The four states of a control share one value: change the normal one to see the others follow.

layout.pageHeaderNote: The header of this page is an sf-page-header: breadcrumb slot (the logo), title, status, actions and the More actions menu.
layout.sideNavNote: sf-side-nav: an area's secondary menu (Publishing, Settings) instead of page tabs. Router links with aria-current, or buttons with current and select; optional group headings and counts. Below 1024 px of container width it collapses into a select.
layout.sideNavNarrow: Narrow: a select above the content

data.tableNote: {count} fake rows with search, filters, sorting, selection and bulk actions.

cards.intro: A card is one instance of a section template; a catalog is an ordered list of cards. The summary after the type is the card's first text field.

states.longSummary: Long summary (truncates, the type does not)

cards.catalogNote: Add at the end or with the + between two cards, drag a card header or press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ in it, duplicate and remove (with Undo) — all in memory. The gallery holds a nested catalog with a single card type, so its add buttons add directly. Collapsed cards are remembered for this browser session.
